# Bluebird Business Consulting, a Canadian corporation

> Creators of Bluebird Ai - AI-powered business plans for Canadian entrepreneurs and small business owners.

Bluebird Business Consulting helps Canadian small business owners, 
contractors, and tradespeople create professional business plans, 
cash flow projections, and funding-ready documents — powered by AI 
and built for the Canadian market.

## Who We Serve

- HVAC contractors
- Plumbers
- Roofers
- Carpenters
- Electricians
- Canadian small business owners
- First-time entrepreneurs

## What We Offer

- Tailored AI-generated business plans in under an hour
- Bilingual service (English & French)

## Location

Canada — serving all provinces and territories
